Date: 9 7 MAR 2018

All Addl. CPFC (Zones)

Subject : Mandatory Online Filing of Returns by Exempted/Relaxed Establishments -
Regarding.

Reference : i) Head Office letter No. C/Misc/Ex-Return/2013/27552 Dated: 27.03.2014 (available at
Office Orders & Circulars 2013-14 page of EPFO Website at SI. No. 833).

ii) Head Office letter No. C/Misc/Ex-Return/2013/1877 Dated: 22.04.2014 (available at
Office Orders & Circulars 2014-15 page of EPFO Website at SI. No. 41).

Sir/Madam,

Attention is drawn to the subject and references cited above. As you are aware, online filing of
returns by exempted/relaxed establishments has been mandated by Order No. C/Misc/Ex-
Return/2013/1087 dated 17.04.2014 (enclosed with the Head Office letter under reference at SI. No. ii)
above). A dashboard to facilitate monitoring of returns by the field offices has also since been developed.

2. In this backdrop, RPFCs were expected to put in place a system for regular monitoring of
dashboard of online returns of exempted establishments and ensure necessary follow up actions. The
issue was also discussed at length with the RPFCs during the course of meeting held on 10.09.2014 to
12.09.2014 in the Head Office (minutes of the meeting were e-mailed to RPFCs of RO and ACC (Zones) on
14.10.2014). However, it is felt that desired result is yet to be achieved by the RPFCs of the field offices in
this regard.

3. Now that the financial year 2014-15 is at its end, and the last part of the online return will be filed
by the exempted/relaxed establishments, it is high time that RPFCs should take a stock of the return filing
status. On the one hand, non filers and belated filers of online returns should be identified and appropriate
actions should be initiated against such defaulter establishments. On the other hand, field offices should
also ensure verification and audit of the online returns filed by the establishments. Details furnished by the
establishments and the Trusts should be checked and verified with reference to office records and if any
inconsistency is noticed the same should be suitably attended to. RPFCs of the field offices are required to
furnish a certificate to the Head Office by 15.05.2015 in this regard.

Yours faithfully

= ON\ 9% Orv
